description: This file defines the TimesheetItemDecorator class, which provides methods to decorate TimesheetItem objects with related entities like Project, ProjectActivity, Timesheet, and Employee by their IDs, and to format the start date of a timesheet item.

classes.name: TimesheetItemDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds convenience methods to manipulate TimesheetItem entities, associating related entities and formatting data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a TimesheetItem object.

methods.name: setProjectById
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with the TimesheetItem by its ID.

methods.name: setProjectActivityById
methods.description: Associates a ProjectActivity entity with the TimesheetItem by its ID.

methods.name: setTimesheetById
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet entity with the TimesheetItem by its ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the TimesheetItem by employee number.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the TimesheetItem.
